summary: Noah Holdings, a Cayman-incorporated, HK-listed (06686) and NYSE-listed wealth manager, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Hong Kong Exchange monthly return for equity issuers for September 2026. The return shows authorised share capital unchanged at 1,000,000,000 ordinary shares of USD 0.00005 par (USD 50,000), issued shares flat at 343,228,815 with zero treasury shares, and no option exercises or new issuance. The company confirms compliance with the 25% minimum public float. No transaction, price, premium or advisor is disclosed; this is a routine post-month-end securities-movement disclosure, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle applies.
